Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $102,920 in Seattle, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Seattle $102,920, Chicago $78,390, Austin $61,270.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
